effects_text: Can wear power armor variants

description: As a purifier of the wasteland, you do +50% damage with Melee and Unarmed weapons against Centaurs, Nightstalkers, Spore Plants, Spore Carriers, Deathclaws, Super Mutants, and Feral Ghouls.
effects_text: You do +50% damage with melee and unarmed weapons against centaurs, night stalkers, spore plants, spore carriers, deathclaws, super mutants, and feral ghouls.

description: With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
effects_text: +50% damage with fire-based weapons

description: Quick Draw makes all of your weapon equipping and holstering 50% faster.
effects_text: Equipping and holstering becomes 50% faster

description: While Waking Cloud is in your party, it is much easier to sneak by the White Legs (their PER is decreased).
effects_text: White Leg Perception is decreased by 3

description: With the Rad Absorption perk, your radiation level slowly decreases on its own over time.
effects_text: Radiation level slowly decreases automatically over time.

description: You truly are a rad child. As you go through the increasingly devastating stages of radiation sickness, you will regenerate more and more health.
effects_text: Bonus to healing while being irradiated

description: Rad Resistance allows you to -- what else? -- resist radiation. This perk grants an additional 25% to Radiation Resistance.
effects_text: +25% Radiation Resistance

description: When caught without their weapons, NCR's rangers rely on the Ranger Takedown to quickly incapacitate opponents. Perform a Power Attack while moving backwards to execute a Ranger Takedown.

requirements.other: Win Andy's Speech Check (30 Speech Req.)

requires_text: Win Andy's Speech Check (30 Speech Req.)
effects_text: Perform a Power Attack while moving backwards to execute a sweeping kick that will knockdown an enemy.

description: Rapid Reload makes all of your weapon reloads 25% faster than normal.
effects_text: 25% faster reload

description: Ghost people are difficult to kill unless dismembered or disintegrated. If Dog is in the party, however, Dog will devour them, preventing them from getting back up.
effects_text: Unconscious ghost people can be eaten by Dog

description: While Raul is a companion, the Condition of weapons and armor decays more slowly.
effects_text: Slows the decay rate of equipment

description: Your spine is back in your body, but some advance technologies remain: Your torso can now be crippled again, but your Strength (STR) and Damage Threshold (DT) bonuses have doubled! (+2)
effects_text: Torso can be crippled again; +2 Strength; +2 DT

description: With the Retention perk, the bonuses granted by skill magazines last three times as long.
effects_text: Skill magazines have a longer duration

description: With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot. Also, sneaking up on a hostile robot undetected and deactivating it will put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.
effects_text: +25% damage to robots and ability to shutdown robots if sneaking up on them

description: You're more at home under the open stars than under a roof. Any time you sleep outside, you gain the benefits of being Well Rested, even if you don't own the bed.
effects_text: Well Rested bonus when you sleep outside, even in an unowned bed

description: The Run 'n Gun perk reduces accuracy penalties with one-handed Guns and Energy Weapons while walking or running.
effects_text: Halves spread with one-handed ranged weapons while moving.

description: Sic semper tyrannis! You can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes. You also gain reputation with the NCR for breaking the back of Caesar's Legion, but you lose reputation with Caesar's Legion.

requirements.other: Launch the nuclear missiles at Caesar's Legion

requires_text: Launch the nuclear missiles at Caesar's Legion
effects_text: +1 SPECIAL point, NCR Fame, Caesar's Legion Infamy

description: While Veronica is a companion, the player can craft Workbench items through Veronica's dialogue.
effects_text: Veronica will craft items for you that can only be crafted at a workbench

description: Scribes in the Brotherhood of Steel are often not well-trained in the combat use of the high-tech gear employed by Paladins. They rely on unarmed defensive moves like the Scribe Counter to keep enemies at bay. Perform a standard attack out of a block hit reaction to execute a Scribe Counter.

requirements.other: Completing You Make Me Feel Like a Woman

requires_text: Completing You Make Me Feel Like a Woman
effects_text: Use the Scribe Counter to swiftly counterattack opponents. Perform a standard attack directly after blocking an incoming attack.

description: With the Scrounger perk, you'll find considerably more ammunition in containers than you normally would.
effects_text: Find more ammunition in containers

description: While Rex is a companion, unequipped chems, firearms, and ammunition within a short distance are highlighted when you zoom the camera.
effects_text: Usable items are marked when zoomed in.

description: You're laser-crazy and it shows! Minor bonus to critically hit with all laser weapons.

requirements.other: Completing the Beam (Weapon) Me Up and Set Lasers for Fun challenges

requires_text: Completing the Beam (Weapon) Me Up and Set Lasers for Fun challenges
effects_text: +2% critical chance with energy weapons per rank

description: With this perk, your precision with a scattergun is something to behold. When using shotguns, regardless of ammunition used, you ignore an additional 10 points of a target's Damage Threshold.
effects_text: When using shotguns, regardless of ammunition used, you ignore an additional 10 points of a target's damage threshold

description: You've learned to make a mysterious edible substance at a Camp Fire out of scrap materials (Cloud residue, Tin Cans, junk food) that provides +75 HP, +4 END, and +2 STR... but watch out, it's also highly addictive (15% chance of addiction).
effects_text: Unlocks the Sierra Madre martini recipe.

description: When Christine is a companion, she grants you a short period of time near a speaker before your bomb collar starts to activate as well as increasing the amount of time before your bomb collar detonates by 50%.
effects_text: Keeps alarms from setting off the collar for a short period of time

description: With the Silent Running perk, running no longer factors into a successful sneak attempt.
effects_text: Sneak and Run without penalties

description: The slayer walks the earth! The speed of all Melee Weapons and Unarmed attacks is increased by 30%.
effects_text: Increases the speed of all melee and unarmed attacks by 30%.

description: You don't take kindly to raiders, junkies, or tribals trying to "settle" or "stay alive" in civilized lands. Against dirty raider and junkie types as well as Zion's tribals you do +15% Damage and have a bonus to hit in V.A.T.S.
effects_text: +15% Damage and x1.25 V.A.T.S. to-hit chance to those of raider, junkie, and tribal "races"

description: With the Sniper perk, your chance to hit an opponent's head in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
effects_text: Increase chance to hit opponent's head in V.A.T.S. by 25%

description: With the Solar Powered perk, you gain an additional 2 points to Strength when in direct sunlight, and slowly regenerate lost Health.
effects_text: +2 Strength and Health regeneration while outdoors during daytime.

description: Your spine has been replaced with advanced technologies: Your torso can no longer be crippled and your Strength (STR) and Damage Threshold (DT) have been increased (+1)
effects_text: Torso can no longer be crippled; +1 Strength; +1 DT

description: When you're deep in enemy territory, you just start chucking grenades and hope for the best. All Explosives have a 25% larger area of effect when they detonate.
effects_text: Explosives have a 25% larger area of effect.

description: While Boone is a companion, hostile targets are highlighted whenever the player is actively aiming.
effects_text: Enemies highlighted while sights are aimed down or zoomed in

description: Your attacks do much less damage to companions, allowing you to liberally spray an area with reckless abandon.
effects_text: Reduces the damage you do to your companions by 75%

description: While Lily is a companion, the duration of Stealth Boys is increased by 200% and all Sneak Attack Critical Hits do an additional 10% damage.
effects_text: Stealth Boys last twice as long; Sneak Attack Criticals +10%

description:
The latest software patch for the Stealth Suit Mk II.
V1.1: Damping Sensors (+10 Sneak)
V1.2: Aural Subnet (+1 PER)
V1.3: Synced Fitment (+1 AGL)
V1.4: Impulse Accelerator (Increased sneak speed)

requirements.other: Complete the last challenge of Project X-13

requires_text: Complete the last challenge of Project X-13
effects_text: Increased sneak speed

description: You gain +5 Damage Threshold against all Melee Weapons and Unarmed attacks and cannot be knocked down in combat.
effects_text: +5 to DT versus Unarmed attacks and Melee Weapons; You cannot be knocked down in combat.

description: Your muscle mass has been enhanced with the Hypertrophy Accelerator, increasing your Strength by 1.
effects_text: +1 to Strength

description: With this perk, you can carry an additional 50 lbs. of equipment.
effects_text: Carry an additional 50 lbs. of equipment

description: Your skin has been toughened by the NEMEAN Sub-Dermal Armor, increasing your total Damage Threshold by 4.
effects_text: +4 to Damage Threshold

description: All Melee Weapons (except thrown) and Unarmed attacks have a chance of knocking your target down.
effects_text: Unarmed and melee weapon attacks have a chance of knocking down your opponent.

description: With each level of Swift Learner your character will gain an additional +10% to experience whenever Experience Points are earned.
effects_text: 10% bonus to Experience Points earned

description: The Tag! perk allows you to select a fourth skill to be a Tag skill, which instantly raises it by fifteen points.
effects_text: Select a fourth skill to be a Tag skill (instantly raises it by 15 points)

description: In some conversations, you gain the ability to initiate combat while terrifying a mob of opponents, sending them fleeing away for safety.
effects_text: Enemies flee for 5 seconds after leaving dialogue (with the optional dialogue option)

description: No more will the NCR continue its aggressive campaign of Eastern expansion. You can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes. You also gain reputation with Caesar's Legion for annihilating the NCR's homeland, but lose reputation with the NCR.

requirements.other: Launch nuclear missiles at the NCR.

requires_text: Launch nuclear missiles at the NCR.
effects_text: +1 SPECIAL point, Caesar's Legion Fame, NCR Infamy

description: Up close and personal, that's how you like it. Your Sneak Attack Criticals with pistols, revolvers, and submachine guns, whether Guns or [[Energy Weapons (Fallout: New Vegas)
effects_text: Extra 20% damage for critical hits with all pistols, revolvers, and SMGs. (see bugs)

description: Any living creature you kill has a 50% chance to have the potent healing items Thin Red Paste or Blood Sausage when looted.
effects_text: All living creatures killed by the Courier have a 50% chance of having thin red paste or blood sausage on them.

description: Your storied past has fallen from memory because everyone thought you died. Your Karma is reset, you inflict +10% damage, and for every 100 points of Karma, you gain 10 Health. You are also immune to critical hits. This perk requires you to have good Karma.
requires_text: Level 50; Good or Very Good Karma
effects_text: +10% damage; +10 HP for every 100 karma points; Karma reset to neutral; Immunity to critical hits

description: Cripple one's limbs.
effects_text: 20% reduction to limb damage received.

description: With the Toughness perk, you gain +3 to overall Damage Threshold. This perk may be taken twice, with the second rank granting an additional +3.
effects_text: Permanent +3 to DT

description: While wearing [[Fallout: New Vegas armor and clothing
effects_text: 10% faster running speed when wearing light or no armor.

description: Your limbs take 50% less damage from Animals, Mutated Animals, and Mutated Insects, you gain +25% resistance to Poison Damage, and can eat Mutated Insects when you're in Sneak mode.
effects_text: 50% less limb damage from Animals, Mutated Animals, and Mutated Insects; +25% Poison Resistance; The ability to eat mutated insects in Sneak mode

description: The warrens of the Divide have taught you to keep your head down. Your movement speed is greatly increased while sneaking in light armor, or when wearing no armor at all.
effects_text: 25% increased moving speed while sneaking in light or no armor.

description: When Dean is a companion, he grants you a short period of time before taking damage inside a toxic cloud as well as reducing the amount of damage you take inside the toxic cloud by 25%.
effects_text: Temporary protection against toxic clouds and reduced damage when inside them.
+50% movement speed for Rex

description: Your martial might is truly legendary. You do a large amount of additional damage through enemy blocks with all [[Melee Weapons (Fallout: New Vegas)
effects_text: You do additional damage through enemy blocks with melee and unarmed attacks

description: Waste not, want not. When you use [[Energy Weapons (Fallout: New Vegas)
effects_text: Recover drained ammunition twice as often for energy weapons and all recipes for recycling recipes are unlocked.

description: You don't just read books, you tear into them. Damaged books you pick up become blank magazines, which you can use to copy your existing skill magazines at a workbench (or convert blank magazines back to books).
effects_text: Damaged books become blank magazines; can copy existing magazines into blank magazines

description: Your senses have become so keen that you can feel the slightest vibration in the ground. You gain +1 Perception and Agility attributes while outside.
effects_text: +1 Perception and +1 Agility while outside

description: You have learned the advanced weapon handling techniques of the New Canaanites. For you, all shots with.45 Auto Pistols have less spread and are twice as likely to score a critical hit.
effects_text: Any .45 Auto pistol has half spread and is twice as likely to score critical hits

description: Weapon Strength Requirements are now 2 points lower than normal for you.
effects_text: Weapon Strength Requirements -2

description: While Follows-Chalk is in your party, reaching any summit in Zion Valley (such as ranger stations) will reveal all nearby map markers and inspire a heightened state of awareness (+3 PER) for three minutes.
effects_text: In any summit of Zion, all nearby map markers are revealed and the Courier gains +3 Perception for three minutes.

description: While Cass is a companion, she and the player gain Damage Threshold when they drink Whiskey. Additionally, the player does not suffer intelligence loss from consuming alcohol and ignores the negative effects of alcohol addiction.
effects_text: No Intelligence penalty from alcohol; Alcohol addiction is suppressed but not prevented or cured; Whiskey and wasteland tequila temporarily increase DT
